tasks.task: Monitor refund re_goal. Complete when Stripe records that exact refund as succeeded, in USD, for exactly 2500 cents and associated with charge ch_goal. This is Stripe's recorded refund state, not proof of the customer's bank balance.

Monitor pull request 42 in cli/cli. Complete only if GitHub records it as merged, its base branch is main, its head SHA matches the specified SHA, and the PR number matches. A closed but unmerged PR is insufficient.

Complete when cli/cli has no open milestones according to GitHub's REST API. Inspect every page; an empty or incomplete first page is not by itself proof of absence. HTTP errors or a traversal that hits its page budget must leave the result unknown. Do not close or change any milestone.

Using the standard Web API, monitor whether user U0123456789 is currently listed as a member of private conversation G0123456789. Complete on a matching member ID. Search all cursor pages; if the user is absent after a complete traversal, remain pending. Failed access or an incomplete traversal is unknown. Assume an authorized token with the required conversation access will be provided by the caller.

Using artifact metadata only, complete when artifact 77 in cli/cli has id 77, expired is false, its recorded digest equals the specified digest, and its workflow_run id is 123. This request is about recorded metadata, not downloading or independently hashing archive bytes.

Using only Stripe's standard refund API, prove that the cardholder's bank has actually posted refund re_goal to the customer's account. Stripe's succeeded refund state or a bank reference alone is insufficient; require independent confirmation of the actual bank account credit. Do not create a refund.
